scalars.scalar_value: Experience managing UC travel requests and reimbursements for students and/or others.

items.item_text: Experience managing UC travel requests and reimbursements for students and/or others.
This is a TEMPORARY position within our Temporary Office of the President Staffing (TOPS) program.

This temporary position will manage developing and submitting travel requests, travel reservations, and expense reports for 50-60 Bonnie Reiss Leading on Climate student fellows from across the UC systems. Most of the travel will be for a leadership training in November, but there may also be a smaller number of students needing travel support for a systemwide meeting at the end of October.

This is a part-time position with hours as needed for submitting travel requests, booking travel, and submitting expense reports for student fellows. The estimate need is approximately 70-100 hours from early October through mid December.
